message: You know that feeling when everyone’s scrambling during a blackout and you’re just calmly sipping your tea? I love being the prepared one for once! There’s a great resource on how to handle power outages that covers everything from keeping food safe to lighting your home. It’s all about making sure you and your loved ones stay comfy and safe when the lights go out. What’s your go-to tip for staying organized during a power outage?
